supersedes: B-GPIO-PLAN-1.0.1; 1.0.2 applies the review corrections: runner hash/path gate, native-exit/count classification, bounded process-tree cleanup, formal TB hard cycle cap, negative TB watchdog, and exact two-edge sync wording. RTL is unchanged; TB hashes and plan hash are new.
scope: GPIO output register and two-stage input synchronizer only; no direction/tristate/debounce/interrupt, no address map, no bus wrapper, no board pin mapping, and no hardware test.

tools.legal_source: Existing lawful local Icarus installation recorded in B-ENV; path passed explicitly, PATH not modified.

design.width: parameter integer W; intended range 1..32; final coverage W=1, 8, 16
design.output_register: gpio_out is a W-bit register; every sampling edge with gpio_wr_en=1 and rst_n=1 writes the complete gpio_wdata; equal values are not de-duplicated
design.hold: when gpio_wr_en=0, gpio_out holds its value regardless of gpio_wdata and gpio_in_async
design.input_synchronizer: two cascaded W-bit registers; gpio_in_async -> sync_meta -> gpio_in_sync; both stages reset to 0
design.input_output_isolation: gpio_in_async is never connected or fed back to gpio_out
design.reset: asynchronous active-low rst_n clears gpio_out, sync_meta and gpio_in_sync to 0; writes while rst_n=0 are ignored
design.readback: gpio_out is the registered output port and the observable value; there is no separate bus read port or address decode
design.excluded: direction control, bidirectional inout, tri-state, debounce, interrupt generation, pin polarity/width adaptation, and CPU bus integration

timing.write_acceptance: one full-width write on each posedge with gpio_wr_en=1 and rst_n=1; no ready/backpressure
timing.sync_latency: a value stable before edge E0 enters sync_meta after E0 and reaches gpio_in_sync after the next rising edge E1; the total is two sampling edges (E0 for stage 1, E1 for stage 2). It is not E0+2 clocks.
timing.input_phase_rule: all four drive points are at least 2 ns from both the preceding and following clock edge; no input is driven at a sampling edge
timing.reset_release: rst_n is released away from a sampling edge
timing.watchdog_cycle_basis: cycle_count is blocking-incremented on every posedge; MAX_CYCLES=N terminates on the Nth posedge. The preserved 1.0.1 watchdog log printed cycles=201/limit=200 and actually terminated on the 202nd posedge; it is not reinterpreted as an exact-200-cycle cutoff.

limitations: No PDS synthesis, place-and-route, timing analysis, JTAG, download, Flash, board pin test, or temperature test was performed; hardware remains stopped.
Simulation verifies logical cycle behavior only, not physical metastability, MTBF, debounce, noise immunity, or board-level input integrity.
Only W=1, 8 and 16 are covered; the module accepts a parameter W but all widths 1..32 are not exhaustively tested.
The four input phases (2,3,7,8 ns in a 10 ns clock) demonstrate logical two-edge delay away from sampling edges; input changes exactly at a sampling edge are not covered.
No direction control, bidirectional inout, tri-state, interrupt, read bus, address map, or CPU integration exists in this core; mainline must add any board pin/polarity adaptation.
The GPIO outputs are not mapped to the board's 8 LEDs or 5 keys; no board-level active-low/active-high assumption is made.
